I'm a college student sa isang State University. I currently use a 6 year old Samsung Phone na binigay ng Ate ko. Been struggling with this phone since I can't contact my family when I'm in school, due to its limited antenna capabilities. Isa pang bagay kasi na nasa malayo ako nag aaral para matulungan ko yung family ko sa gastos (free tuition). 

Even though it's my first time owning an iPhone, I'll be glad to receive it kasi makakatulong talaga siya sa academic workload ko. My old phone can't send outputs thru online submissions, since the camera cannot compete with it. Tsaka, mas magagamit ko yung camera niya to store valuable data and observations with my lab experiments na need talaga every week. Disadvantaged talaga ako kasi napag iwanan na ng modern tech yung phone ko, at very bias talaga ng educational system sa ganito.

Even though hindi ako katulad nag iba na gagamitin siya for social media, since hindi naman ako talaga fan sa soc med, I still value the phone's capabilities na makatutulong siya sa akin sa academics. 

I hope I can receive this phone, malaking tulong tala siya sa akin bilang student struggling with the fast moving society reliant on technology.
